description: Yoshito Kikuchi is a character from the anime and manga series Great Teacher Onizuka, and extremely intelligent with an IQ of 18-. He specifically is quite smart when it comes to computers, and used that skill to edit photos doing bad or perverse things to make them quit school. But, after seeing the tenacity of Onizuka, he changed his ways.

excerpt: A character from the Nickelodeon show Victorious.
description: Jade West is one of the eight main characters of the Nickelodeon show Victorious. She's fits the role of the goth character, and is very antagonistic to the main character Tori Vega, and can won't hesitate to make it known when other characters do her wrong, too.

excerpt: A Nickelodeon TV show from 2010.
description: Victorious is a Nickelodeon TV show from 2010 following 8 main characters at the school Hollywood Arts, trying to make it big in the arts. The main character is Tori Vega, but many plots follow the other 7 characters, and is mostly an ensemble show.

excerpt: A character from the anime and manga series Grand Blue.
description: Sakurako Busujima is a character from the anime and manga series Grand Blue, and considers herself a hard work in the realm of love. She's always very nice in front of men she likes, and nice in general to most people, but extremely sadistic to people who get on her bad side. She also struggles expressing her real feelings.

excerpt: An anime and manga series about diving.
description: Grand Blue, also known as Grand Blue Dreaming, is an anime and manga series about diving, in which an the main character Iori Kitahara has to move in with his uncle who owns a diving shop since it's close to his college. He's excited, but that quickly goes away when he finds that the diving club full of buff men who spend more time drinking and stripping naked than diving. He tries to distance himself, but he gets swept up with them, and eventually becomes one of them.

excerpt: A manga based on the Cowboy Bebop series.
description: Cowboy Bebop: Shooting Star is a 2 volume manga based on the Cowboy Bebop anime. Despite this, it does not tell stories from the anime, instead opting to tell original stories. I read it a while a ago, and it was interesting enough, but I don't know if I would recommend it or not.

excerpt: A trilogy of parody spy films.
description: Austin Powers is a trilogy of parody spy films, largely parodying the likes of James Bond, but containing parodies and references to other media. It takes place in "modern day" (the 90s), and follows the titular Austin Powers, who gets frozen in the 60s to end up in modern day, and defeat Dr. Evil.

excerpt: A manga series by Rumiko Takahashi.
description: Mao is a manga series by Rumiko Takahashi and follows Nanoka Kiba, who one day gets transported to the Taishō period (early 1900s) of Japan, meeting with a traveler name Mao, who is investigating a village inhabited by ghosts. Nanoka then consistently travels between her time and the past, investigating different phenomena with Mao and helping him in any way she can.

excerpt: One of the main characters from the Mao manga series.
description: Born 900 years ago, Mao was trained and tested as part of the Kou Clan in the way of spirits and the like. But, then he and 4 other disciples were tasked with killing each other for ownership of the clan, none of them able to die other than by each other's hand. Not only this, but Mao was saved by a demon named Byoki who's head wants to reclaim the rest of his body that's a part of Mao.

excerpt: The main character of the Mao manga series.
description: Nanoka Kiba is the main character of the Mao manga series. When she was a child, she got in an accident, and just like Mao, has the cat demon Byoki's blood in her. She doesn't let this bother her too much, though. She's a brave and curious person and is determined to help Mao in any way she can.

excerpt: A type of Japanese supernatural creature.
description: An ayakashi is a name used for a subset of Yokai who appear at the surface of water. Almost think evil water spirits. In terms of the manga series Mao, ayakashi typically refers to animal based spirits.

excerpt: A sitcom about one guy and two girls living together.
description: Three's Company is a late 70s and early 80s sitcom about roommates Jack Tripper, Janet Wood, and Chrissy Snow (as well as other roommates later on) who live together in Santa Monica to save money. To make this arrangement work with their landlord, though, Jack has to pretend to be gay, and the show follows the antics of that, as well as other sitcom plots. Despite the not greatly aged premise, I really like this show, and it actually aged better than you might think since Mr. Roper (the landlord) is often made fun of for how he views gay people.

excerpt: A visual novel series about vampires.
description: Tsukihime is a visual novel series made by Type-Moon and released in 2000. It follows Shiki Tohno, a young man with the ability to "see death." This ability gets him entangled with the vampire/vampire hunter Arcueid Brunestud, and along with a cast of other strange characters, try to defeat Roa.

excerpt: A character from the anime and manga series Grand Blue.
description: Aina Yoshiwara is a character from the anime and manga series Grand Blue, and is one of the major characters. She is often referred to as "Cakey" due to her former (and sometimes present) excessive use of make up. When she wears her make up, she is much less shy than her normal self, and will partake in the diving club's drinking and stripping.

excerpt: An action role-playing game made by Game Freak.
description: Pokémon Legends: Arceus is an action role-playing game made by Game Freak, and is a Pokémon game that takes place far in the past. The player gets transported from the present day Sinnoh region to the past region of Hisui, and has to go about researching and catching Pokémon in an era where that is a brand new thing.

excerpt: A personal acquaintance of mine from my required schooling days.
description: Henry (not his real name) was an acquaintance from my required schooling days. We were friends, but we kind of ended up taking our own paths, which naturally does happen. It also partly happened because he tried being one of the "cool kids" by smoking when we were middle school, but he ended up pretty well adjusted by high school.

excerpt: A YouTuber who focuses on technology.
description: Austin Evans is a YouTuber who focuses on technology, often delving into if products are scams or not. He ranges his topics of conversation from video games consoles to personal computer to things that are more out there like toasters.

excerpt: A Japanese visual novel studio.
description: Key is a Japanese visual novel studio formed in 1998 under the Visual Arts. It's most known for producing visual novels such as Kanon, Air, and Clannad. Key has also collaborated with P.A. Works and Aniplex to create three original anime series, Angel Beats!, Charlotte, and The Day I Became a God.

excerpt: A character from the Clannad series.
description: Fuko Ibuki is a character from the Clannad series, and one of the main dateable heroines in the visual novel. She's a very strange girl, having a very childish perspective on just about everything. There's a lot more to her, especially when it comes to why she acts like that, but that is spoiler territory.

excerpt: A person I knew in high school.
description: Madison (not her real name) was someone I sort of knew in high school. She originated from middle school, but was in Pamela's class, but everybody knew everybody a little bit back then, even if only by name. She then would pop up here and there in high school to talk to Pamela. From what I understood, she was one of the "popular" girls, but I very well could be wrong.

excerpt: A person I knew in middle school.
description: Amanda (not her real name) was someone I knew in middle school. We didn't really know each other that well, but we probably interacted more than we otherwise would because me, Victor, and Daniel were friends with her friend.

excerpt: A gaming YouTuber and streamer.
description: Northernlion is a gaming YouTuber and streamer who originally got popular by playing The Binding Of Isaac, and the creator of the game even credits some of the sales to him. Personally, I started watching him because I was curious as to what Nubby's Number Factory was.

excerpt: A company that makes plastic construction toys.
description: Lego is a company that makes plastic construction toys in the form of bricks. They also come in many other shapes, prepackaged sets, and different licensed themes. One of the most iconic parts about Lego is the simple Lego man.

excerpt: A car most known for its use in Back to the Future.
description: The DMC DeLorean was a car produced by the DeLorean motor company in 1981 and 1982. If you know this car, there's a 99.9% chance that it's because of Back to the Future, being the time machine in that series of movies. To be honest, I'm not a car guy, so I don't know if it's a good car or not. Though, I do know it can hit 88 miles per hour.

excerpt: A friend from high school gym class.
description: Sam (not his real name) was a friend from high school gym class. We talked and such outside of gym, but he was one of the friends you're kind of only friends with for a class. He was very nice, though, and we dubbed him big Sam in a nice way, since he was big horizontally and vertically (he was also comically big next to standard male Sam).

excerpt: The first entry in the New Super Mario Bros. series.
description: New Super Mario Bros. DS is the first entry in the New Super Mario Bros. series, and was the first 2D Mario game in quite some time at the time. It follows the standard formula of running and jumping, but adds new power ups, and moves that Mario only used in the 3D games until then.

excerpt: A fan made modification to a preexisting game.
description: A rom hack is a fan made modification to a preexisting game, typically adding new content, or changing the already existing content. This is typically done with programs made specifically for the game to rom hacked. For example, the program Lunar Magic is used to make Super Mario World rom hacks.

excerpt: A handheld gaming console by Nintendo.
description: The Nintendo DS is a handheld gaming console made by Nintendo and released in 2004. It had the two unique gimmicks of having not only two screens, but having the bottom screen be a touch screen, which was quite novel at the time. Because of this, and the marketing being aimed towards not just gamers, it sold extremely well.

excerpt: An upgraded revision of the Game Boy Advance.
description: The Game Boy Advance SP is an upgraded revision of the original Game Boy Advance, featuring a brand new clam shell design to protect the screen, and a screen light. There were even two versions of the Game Boy Advance SP, with the second having a backlight instead of a front light.

excerpt: A remake of the original Pokémon Red.
description: Pokémon FireRed, is a remake of the first generation of Pokémon, specifically Pokémon Red, and paired with Pokémon LeafGreen, based on the Japanese exclusive Pokémon Green. It released in 2004 for the Game Boy Advance, and features update graphics, music, mechanics, and the new Pokémon from generation 2 and 3.

excerpt: A location from Pokémon Ruby, Sapphire, and Emerald.
description: Petalburg Woods is a location from Pokémon Ruby, Sapphire, and Emerald, and is one of the early locations in the game. It also follows the trope of Pokémon games having a forest location early on in the game.

excerpt: A 1970s British rock band.
description: Queen is a 1970s British rock band, most known for Freddie Mercury as the lead singer. The band has done many songs, and many famous songs such as I Want To Break Free, We Will Rock You, Don't Stop Me Now, and many, many more.

excerpt: A song by the band Huey Lewis and the News.
description: Hip to Be Square is a song by the band Huey Lewis and the News, and released on October 6th, 1986. It is most known for its use in the hit film American Psycho, and has been parodied many times specifically because of the scene from the movie using it.

excerpt: The main character of the Shantae video game series.
description: Shantae is the main character of the Shantae video game series made by WayForward. She is half human, and half genie, and as a result, is the guardian of Scuttle Town. She is often fighting against her rival, Risky Boots, who wants wealth and power.

excerpt: A character from the Neon Genesis Evangelion series.
description: Misato Katsuragi is a character from the Neon Genesis Evangelion series, and is the head of the operations department at Nerv, an agency dedicated to defeating Angels which threaten humanity. She does extremely well at her job, but hides her intelligence at home with her vices of sex and alcohol.

excerpt: A popular video sharing platform.
description: YouTube is a popular video sharing platform that was founded on Valentines Day of 2005. Pretty much everyone knows what YouTube is, and many people make a living off of it in one way or another. The scale of YouTube is incredible, with more than 500 hours of video being published per minute as of 2019, and has likely only increased.

excerpt: A person who makes videos for the video sharing platform YouTube.
description: A YouTuber is a person who makes videos for the video sharing platform YouTube, typically making some sort of revenue from ads or sponsorships, but that's not a requirement. As weird as it is to some, this is just a standard job now, just with an extremely lucky barrier to entry.

excerpt: An instant messaging and social media platform.
description: Discord is an instant messaging and social media platform where people communicate in private or public servers. It was mostly made with gaming in mind, but many people simply use it as their main form of communication.

excerpt: An old man in our neighbourhood.
description: The Old Man is a nice old man in our neighbourhood, who would share stories and even play video games with us sometimes. He's still around, and we talk every once in a while, but things are a bit different now that we have grown up.

excerpt: A web based graphic design platform.
description: Canva is a web based graphic design platform that was founded on January 1st, 2013. Many people use it for various things such as posters, presentations, workshops, and even more. I even used it back in high school, and for one of my jobs.

excerpt: Stands for Non-Player Character, typically referring to video games.
description: NPC is an acronym that stands for Non-Player Character, and typically refers to characters in video games that can't be played as. But, in recent times, it has been used to describe the energy some people give off, if they repeat common phrases, or do the same actions over and over again.

excerpt: A Pokémon from the first generation of Pokémon games.
description: Charizard is a Pokémon from the first generation of Pokémon games, and represents the Pokémon Red game. Charizard is one of the most popular Pokémon, getting many different forms, pieces of merchandise, and whatever else.

excerpt: A Canadian children's toy company.
description: Mega Bloks is a Canadian children's toy company, and subsidiary of Mattel. It is most known for its Lego-style construction toys, and brand collaborations with SpongeBob, Pokémon, and more.

excerpt: A type of vending machine that dispenses toys in capsules.
description: A Gashapon machine is a type of vending machine that dispenses toys in small capsules. The name comes from two Japanese onomatopoeia, "gasha," the sound of the hand turning the crank with the coin, and "pon," the sound of the capsule hitting the collection tray.

excerpt: A British comedy troupe formed in the late 60s.
description: Monty Python is a British comedy troupe formed in the late 60s, and became popular though their sketch comedy series Monty Python's Flying Circus. It was a ground breaking show at the time in terms of pushing what could be done on TV.

excerpt: Someone I knew in elementary and middle school.
description: Barry (not his real name) was someone I (and we all) knew in elementary school and middle school. He was a grade failer, and not the sad kind where personal circumstance gets in the way of doing well. He just didn't want to put the effort in, but that's not why we all knew him. One time in science, the actual principal came in and gave him a bag of personal hygiene stuff since he stunk so bad.

excerpt: A YouTuber who makes challenge videos.
description: yikes is a YouTuber who makes challenge videos, often trying to complete a certain task over a relatively short period of time. For example, in one video he tried to become the most popular person on the Lego social media Lego Life in 30 days.

excerpt: Someone I knew in elementary and middle school.
description: Alec (not his real name) was someone I knew in elementary and middle school. He was one of the "cool kids" back then, but I don't really remember to much about him. I think he kind of transitioned from cool kid, to just trying to get through school kid, but I can't say for sure. He also always wore a bucket hat.

excerpt: The main character of the anime and manga series Bocchi the Rock!.
description: Hitori Gotoh is the main character of the anime and manga series Bocchi the Rock!. She's very introverted, but with a strong want to perform in a band to show off what she can do, and this led her to playing the guitar. SHe is very skilled but her introverted nature gets in the way.

excerpt: An American paid TV channel consisting largely of cartoons.
description: Nickelodeon is an American paid TV channel consisting largely of cartoons, but with exceptions. It is known for many different pieces of children's programming, but it is most known for the likes of SpongeBob SquarePants, Rugrats, The Loud House, and many, many more.

excerpt: A trilogy of superhero movies.
description: The Spider-Man movies are a trilogy of superhero movies directed by Sam Raimi, and released throughout the 2000s. They're known for their incredible special effects, and for reviving the concept of the superhero movie after Superman 4 had killed the idea.

excerpt: A Japanese mecha franchise.
description: Neon Genesis Evangelion is a Japanese mecha franchise, with the anime airing from 1995 to 1996. It takes place in a post apocalyptic 2015 after the world changing event of the Second Impact. It follows 3 children, Shinji Ikari, Rei Ayanami, and Asuka Langley Soryu who have to fight in giant robots called Evangelions to defeat the angels which are threatening the world.

excerpt: A mecha from the Neon Genesis Evangelion series.
description: Evangelion Unit-01 is a mecha from the Neon Genesis Evangelion series, and is a prototype from the Evangelion series. As a result, it goes into berserk mode sometimes, acting independently from its pilot, outside instruction, or even power.

excerpt: An American film production and distribution company.
description: Paramount Pictures, often known as just Paramount, is an American film production and distribution company, and is one of the oldest film studios in the world. It has produced and released many films such as the Top Gun movies, Titanic, and the transformers movies.

excerpt: A Canadian chain of discount supermarkets.
description: No Frills is a Canadian chain of discount supermarkets. My family shops there a lot, and I personally used to buy DVDs there when they had them, which they sadly no longer do.

excerpt: Someone I knew in elementary and middle school.
description: Janet (not her real name) was someone I knew in elementary and middle school, and someone I didn't really interact with too much. She would be nice sometimes, indifferent other times, and rude even otherer times. She's probably alright now, but I don't know. She also had a crush on one of my friends apparently.

excerpt: A character from the Neon Genesis Evangelion series.
description: Ritsuko Akagi is a character from the Neon Genesis Evangelion series, and is the head scientist at Nerv, and often takes charge in repairing the Evangelions as well as the defenses of Tokyo-3. She is also the daughter of Naoko Akagi, the developer of Nerv's supercomputer system, Magi.

excerpt: A LNER Class A3-4-6-2 Pacific steam train.
description: The Flying Scotsman is a LNER Class A3-4-6-3 Pacific steam train, built for the London and North Eastern Railway back in 1923. It is known as the world's most famous steam engine, running many lines both pre and post restoration.

excerpt: A brand of phone made by Samsung.
description: The Samsung Galaxy is a brand of phone made by Samsung that started in 2015. Other than phones, the series also includes laptops, headphones, watches, and tablets. The Samsung Galaxy series is known for bringing the Android operating system into the mainstream.

excerpt: A wireless computer mouse made by Apple.
description: The Magic Mouse is a wireless computer mouse made by apple, and released in late 2009. There are 2 generations of Magic Mouse, with three revisions total. The first used AA batteries, the second used a rechargeable battery with Apple's proprietary charging cable, and the most recent uses USB-C.

excerpt: A character from the Kid Icarus series.
description: Palutena is a character from the Kid Icarus series, and the Goddess of Light. She is kind and benevolent, but can be petty at times, especially so since she's a goddess. She is also the ruler of Angel Land, and gives the main character, Pit, his ability to fly.

excerpt: An American superhero who appears in comics made by DC Comics.
description: Batman is an American superhero who appears in comic made by DC Comics, and was created by Bob Kane and Bill Finger. First appearing in Detective Comics issue 27 on March 30th, 1939, Batman has become one of the most iconic superheros of the 20th and 21st centuries.

excerpt: The alter-ego of the superhero Batman
description: Bruce Wayne is the alter-ego of the superhero Batman, and is often depicted as a rich, philanthropist playboy. In actuality, he's Batman, deciding to become a superhero after the deaths of both his parents at the hands of Joe Chill.

excerpt: A subscription box service established in 2012.
description: Loot Crate is a subscription box service established in 2012, and provides monthly boxes with pop culture related items. They've had many different brands partner with them including Nintendo, DC, Marvel, Sega, Sony, and more.

excerpt: An animated fantasy action TV show.
description: Avatar: The Last Airbender is an animated fantasy action TV show made by Michael Dante DiMartino and Bryan Konietzko. It follows Aang, the last survivor of the air benders, and the Avatar, a person who can manipulate all four elements (water, earth, fire, air). He, along with his friends, have to prevent the fire nation from taking over the world.

excerpt: The main character of Avatar: The Last Airbender.
description: Aang is the main character of Avatar: The Last Airbender. He is the Avatar, which makes him able to control all four elements (water, earth, fire, air). He is also the last of his kind, being frozen in ice for 100 years, and with the help of his friends, needs to reclaim the world from the fire nation.

excerpt: A character from the Looney Tunes series.
description: Yosemite Sam is a character from the Looney Tunes series, and is depicted as an angry, gun wielding outlaw. He is one of the many enemies of Bug Bunny, and naturally, is always outsmarted by the rabbit.

excerpt: A sandbox voxel based video game.
description: Minecraft is a sandbox, voxel based video game that released in 2011 by Mojang Studios, though the first public alpha was released in 2009. It is considered one of the most popular games of all time, with over 350 million copies sold, and over 140 million active monthly players.

excerpt: A creature from the video game Minecraft.
description: The Enderman is a creature from the video game Minecraft, and is seen teleporting and picking up blocks. It is normally neutral, but when either attacked, or looked at in the eyes, they will attack the player.

excerpt: A home video game console by Microsoft.
description: The Xbox 360 is a home video game console by Microsoft, and is the second console made by Microsoft. It released at the end of 2005, being a part of the seventh generation of video game consoles along with the PlayStation 3 and Nintendo Wii.

excerpt: A naturally generated structure from the video game Minecraft.
description: The Woodland Mansion is a naturally generated structure from the video game Minecraft, and is found in dark forests and pale gardens, often far away from the spawn point of the world. They are typically filled with vindicators and evokers, hostile mobs that will attack the player.

excerpt: An animated television show for preschoolers.
description: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse is an animated television show for preschoolers featuring Mickey, Minnie, Donald, Daisy, Goofy and Pluto who interact with the viewers to simulate them solving the problem contained within an episode of the show.

excerpt: An American comedy musician.
description: "Weird Al" Yankovic is an American comedy musician, and is known for making parody songs of preexisting songs, poking fun at the original. He has made more than 150 songs, done more than 1000 live shows, and has made various appearance on TV.

excerpt: A British singer, songwriter and pianist.
description: Elton John is a British singer, songwriter and pianist. He's most known for his music, as well as his showmanship, often wearing very flamboyant outfits. He has had a large impact on the music industry, having sold over 300 million records sold worldwide.

excerpt: An American fast food chain.
description: McDonald's is an American fast food chain, and has the second most locations in the world, only behind Mixue Ice Cream & Tea. It was founded in 1940, and the classic golden arches were introduced in 1953. It is one of the most popular locations not just in America, but in the world.

excerpt: A British reality television show.
description: Supernanny is a British reality television show about parents who can't control their children, and call in the professional nanny Jo Frost, who tries to not only help discipline the children, but teach the parents how to do things properly in the future.

excerpt: A sugar-coated chocolate confectionery.
description: M&M's are a sugar-coated chocolate confectionery that were introduced by the Mars Wrigley Confectionery part of Mars INc. in late 1941. They come in various colours and flavours, and are known worldwide. They are also known for the anthropomorphic representations of each M&M colour to advertise the candy.

excerpt: A Japanese toy company.
description: Tomy, also known as Takara Tomy, is a Japanese toy company that was established in 1924. It is known for making toys for many franchises including Pokémon, Thomas & Friends, Animal Crossing, Beyblade, Astro Boy, and many more.

excerpt: A character from the Thomas & Friends franchise.
description: Rusty is a character from the Thomas & Friends franchise, and is a narrow gauge diesel engine that does maintenance work and other odd jobs on the Skarloey railway. He his kind, and always tries his best to get his work done, but some engines are rude to him, since many other diesels aren't kind.

term: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
excerpt: An action-adventure game by Nintendo.
description: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is an action-adventure game by Nintendo, released in 1998 for the Nintendo 64. It was the first Legend of Zelda game to use 3D graphics, and redefined what the series could be at that point. It is also considered the greatest game of all time by many gaming publications.

excerpt: A home video game console by Sony.
description: The PlayStation, also known as the PSX and PS1, is a home video game console by Sony, releasing in 1994. It was designed with 3D graphics in mind, but had quite a few 2D games released for it as well. It is most known for birthing great game series such as Crash Bandicoot, Spyro the Dragon, and more.

excerpt: A role-playing game made by Square.
description: Final Fantasy VII is a role-playing game made by Square, and released in 1997 for the PlayStation. It follows the mercenary Cloud Strife who joins an eco-terrorist group to stop a corporation from using the planet as an energy source. It was the first Final Fantasy game not released for a Nintendo console, and despite it's name, was the 4th Final Fantasy game to release in the west.

excerpt: A home video game console by Nintendo.
description: The Nintendo 64 is a home video game console by nintendo, and released on June 23rd, 1996. It was the first 3D console made by Nintendo, and introduced the world to Super Mario 64, the game that showed that 3D graphics were the future of video games.

term: The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask
excerpt: An action-adventure game by Nintendo.
description: The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask is an action-adventure game by Nintendo. Releasing in 2000 as the sequel to The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time, Majora's Mask uses the same engine, and many of the same characters from its predecessor. Though, it makes up for this with it's unique mechanics, and 3 day time limit.

term: Dairy of a Wimpy Kid: Dog Days
excerpt: A book in the Dairy of a Wimpy Kid series.
description: Dairy of a Wimpy Kid: Dog Days is a book in the Dairy of a Wimpy Kid series, and the fourth book overall. It follows Greg Heffley, who just wants to spend his Summer indoors, and playing video games all day. But, his mother prevents this, and Greg has to find out what to do, getting in trouble as a result.

excerpt: A line of Thomas toys.
description: Capsule Plarail is a line of Thomas toys from Japan. They are small, wind up versions of the Thomas characters that are small enough to fit in capsules so they can be dispensed from gacha machines. Not only does it have almost every single Thomas character made in the line, but it has various versions of many characters.

excerpt: A character from the Thomas & Friends franchise.
description: Percy is a character from the Thomas & Friends franchise. He is a small, green, saddle tank engine, and has a very naive and cheeky personality. He will fall victim to pranks by the bigger engines and his friends, but will just as easily do the same to them.

excerpt: A line of Thomas toys.
description: TrackMaster is a line of Thomas toys, and was made after Tomy lost the rights to make the Tomy Thomas toys (except for in Japan) to HiT Toy Company. So, HiT rebranded the line to TrackMaster, keeping the molds for the trains largely the same, but introducing many new characters, and changing the track to be more simple.

excerpt: A character from the Neon Genesis Evangelion series.
description: Toji Suzuhara is a character from the Neon Genesis Evangelion series, and one of the classmates of the main character, Shinji Ikari. He used to hate Shinji, since in his first battle, he ended up hurting Toji's younger sister. But after finding out exactly what it was like to pilot an Evangelion, he understood Shinji more, and ended up becoming friends with him.

excerpt: A liquid from the Neon Genesis Evangelion series.
description: LCL is a liquid from the Neon Genesis Evangelion series, and is found in the Entry Plug of Evangelion units. It is the only thing that is required for a pilot to sync with an Evangelion, and is a liquid that can be breathed in. Is is sometimes spelled as an abbreviation (L.C.L) and is theorized to stand for Link Connected Liquid.

excerpt: An American review comedy web series.
description: Nostalgia Critic is an American review comedy web series, created by and staring Doug Walker, who play the Nostalgia Critic. The Nostalgia Critic is an angry, shrill voiced reviewer who watches bad movies and makes fun of them, encompassed by his tagline of "I remember it so you don't have to."

excerpt: A YouTube client for Roku.
description: Playlet is a YouTube client for Roku that is open source, privacy driven, and automatically blocks adds and skips sponsored segments in videos. If you want to have anything resembling a good experience using YouTube on TV, I would highly recommend it.

excerpt: A brand of consumer electronics.
description: Roku is a brand of consumer electronics, mainly consisting of streaming boxes and TVs. The TVs have the streaming boxes built in, and have many different applications to stream not only movies and TV, but things like YouTube, and other apps.

excerpt: A Japanese toy train line.
description: Plarail is a Japanese toy train line made by Tomy, and mainly consisting of blue plastic track, with plastic, battery operated, motorized trains. Though, it launched in 1959 with hand powered trains, it is known for the motorized trains. It is also known for its line of Thomas toys, also following the blue plastic track and plastic, battery operated, motorized train formula.

excerpt: An anime about the descendant of the Shinsengumi.
description: Soar High! Isami is an anime about Isami Hanaoka, a fifth grader who is the descendant of the Shinsengumi, a group of samurai who protected the Tokugawa shogunate during the Bakumatsu period. She, along with her classmates (who are also descendants of the Shinsengumi) find strange artifacts, and have to fight the evil Kurotengu organization.
